    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">OpenObserve日志分析平台</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>一、概述</h1>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u3bb7c132" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">OpenObserve 是一款开源的云原生可观测性平台，专为日志、指标和追踪数据分析设计，相较于Elasticsearch，其存储成本降低了约140倍，支持PB级数据处理，并提供高性能分析与易用部署方案。</span></p>
<div class="cos-accordion-panel-header">
<div class="accordion-panels-link-header_3iv03">
<div><span class="accordion-panels-title_12473">OpenObserve 核心功能与技术特性</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cos-accordion-panel-content">
<div class="                            accordion-panels-content_3WJL9                            cos-space-pb-none                                                                                ">
<div id="1" class="ai-entry">
<div data-show="block_summary" data-show-ext="{&quot;component_content&quot;:{&quot;component_name&quot;:&quot;markdown&quot;,&quot;component_type&quot;:&quot;abstract&quot;,&quot;reference_type&quot;:&quot;&quot;},&quot;hasCredibleRef&quot;:false,&quot;entity_num&quot;:0}">
<div class="link-wrapper_2Zcj9">
<div class="cosd-markdown">
<div class="cosd-markdown-content ">
<div class="marklang">
<ul>
<li>‌多模态数据支持‌：兼容日志、指标、追踪（OpenTelemetry）、实时用户监控（RUM）等数据类型，支持SQL和PromQL混合查询。‌‌<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId"><br></span></span></span></span></li>
<li>‌存储成本优化‌：采用列式存储（Parquet格式）与对象存储（如S3/Azure Blob），压缩效率高，实测日志存储成本仅为Elasticsearch的1/140。‌‌<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId"><br></span></span></span></span></li>
<li>‌高性能架构‌：基于Rust开发，利用向量化处理（SIMD指令集）与无状态节点设计，实现计算存储分离，支持PB级数据实时分析。‌‌<span><span><span class="cos-tooltip cosd-citation"><span class="cosd-citation-citationId"><br></span></span></span></span></li>
<li>‌全托管兼容性‌：提供Docker快速部署方案，支持本地化集群与云原生环境（如Kubernetes），可通过内网穿透实现远程监控。‌‌</li>





</ul>





</div>





</div>





</div>





</div>





</div>





</div>





</div>





</div>
<p class="ne-p">包含的组件如下：</p>
<p class="ne-p"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114133512327-349121536.png" alt="562987-20250302112645278-352672793" width="1366" height="585" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>为啥要用OpenObserve呢？因为接触到项目，资源有限，部署elk太耗资源了。所以需要一个支持链路追踪，同时能收集java日志的。OpenObserve就可以完美实现了。</p>
<p>看一下效果图</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>链路追踪</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114134946665-851562357.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;java日志</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114134741420-1278078000.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;k8s pod监控</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114135048794-957736814.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1>二、安装</h1>
<p>这里使用k8s安装，准备以下yaml文件</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>secret.yaml</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: oo</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">admin
  namespace: default
type: Opaque
data:
  # </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">abcd@1234</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> | base64 -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">w0
  password: YWJjZEAxMjM0</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;说明：</p>
<p>这里密码使用base64加密，使用上面的命令，就可以得到加密字符串。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>StatefulSet.yaml</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>apiVersion: apps/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: openobserve
  namespace: default
spec:
  serviceName: openobserve
  replicas: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: openobserve
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: openobserve
    spec:
      containers:
      </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: openobserve
        image: public.ecr.aws</span>/zinclabs/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">openobserve:latest
        ports:
        </span>- containerPort: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5080</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          name: http
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">env</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: ZO_COMPACT_ENABLED
          value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: ZO_COMPACT_INTERVAL
          value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">3600</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>            # 秒，<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 小时检查一次
        </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: ZO_COMPACT_DATA_RETENTION_DAYS
          value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>              # 保留 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 天
        </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: ZO_ROOT_USER_EMAIL
          value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">root@example.com</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: ZO_ROOT_USER_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: oo</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">admin
              key: password
        </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: ZO_DATA_DIR
          value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 1000m
            memory: 2Gi
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: 500Mi
        volumeMounts:
        </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: data
          mountPath: </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">data
      volumes:
      </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: pvc</span>-dev</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>注意：这里数据是挂载在pvc的/data目录。 pvc云平台已经创建好了，这里直接使用。 如果你没有pvc，请手动创建好。</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>注意：挂载到数据目录/data，首次加载后，密码会写入到文件，之后就不能修改密码了。如果要修改，只能清空/data目录，重新加载即可。</strong></span></p>
<p>这里设定的是OpenObserve登录用户名为root@example.com，密码就是上面的abcd@1234，数据保留30天。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>service.yaml</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: openobserve
  namespace: default
spec:
  type: NodePort
  ports:
  </span>- port: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5080</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    targetPort: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5080</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    name: http
  selector:
    app: openobserve</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;启动OpenObserve</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>kubectl apply -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f secret.yaml
kubectl apply </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f service.yaml
kubectl apply </span>-f StatefulSet.yaml</pre>
</div>
<p>等待几分钟，查看pod是否运行正常</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># kubectl get pods
NAME            READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
openobserve</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>     Running   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>          162m</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>使用ingress发布域名访问，这里直接云平台，点点点就完成了。</p>
<p>访问页面：http://域名</p>
<p>输入用户名和密码</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114140331888-66824405.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;登录之后，默认是空数据，需要进行接入。</p>
<h1 class="ne-p">三、java程序接入</h1>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u082e6039" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">下载agent，访问github，下载最新版本</span></p>
<p id="u73435053" class="ne-p"><a class="ne-link" href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/releases" target="_blank" data-href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/releases" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="ne-text">https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/releases</span></a></p>
<p id="u7d8297d4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">启动命令模板</span></p>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>java -javaagent:./opentelemetry-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">javaagent.jar \
     </span>-Dotel.exporter.otlp.endpoint=http:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;OpenObserve_IP&gt;:5080/api/default \</span>
     -Dotel.exporter.otlp.protocol=http/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">protobuf \
     </span>-Dotel.exporter.otlp.compression=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">gzip</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
     </span>-Dotel.exporter.otlp.headers=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Authorization=Basic &lt;base64(用户:TOKEN)&gt;,stream-name=&lt;你的流名&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
     </span>-Dotel.service.name=my-java-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">app \
     </span>-jar your-app.jar</pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u3cf20fe2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">参数说明</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="udcebf4f6" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">&lt;base64(用户:TOKEN)&gt;</span></code><span class="ne-text">：例如 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">root@example.com:abcd@1234</span></code><span class="ne-text"> →&nbsp;cm9vdEBleGFtcGxlLmNvbTphYmNkQDEyMzQ=</span></span></li>
<li id="udff9f3bc" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">stream-name</span></code><span class="ne-text">：OpenObserve 里用来区分业务的数据流，可随意起，查询时会当成表名。</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u4c18f177" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u3980f355" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">计算base64，使用以下命令</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">root@example.com:abcd@1234</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> | base64 -w0</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>以上命令太长了，<span class="ne-text">可以直接通过k8s环境变量注入进去</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
  value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://openobserve.default:5080/api/default</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL
  value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http/protobuf</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_COMPRESSION
  value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">gzip</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
  value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Authorization=Basic cm9vdEBleGFtcGxlLmNvbTphYmNkQDEyMzQ=,stream-name=你的应用名</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
  value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你的应用名</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER
  value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">otlp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name: OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER
  value: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">otlp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后java的dockerfile，启动命令为：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>java $JAVA_OPTS -javaagent:/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar -jar /app.jar</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>等应用都发布完成之后，就可以看到日志了</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114141349586-1774283021.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>点击数据流，这里可以看到你接入了多少应用</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114141247370-1328479544.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1>三、数据源Kubernetes</h1>
<p>点击数据源，选择Kubernetes</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114142309211-750663177.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;以上命令，都是要执行的，但是缺少helm命令</p>
<p>安装helm，使用官方脚本</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>curl -fsSL -o get_helm.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span> https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">chmod</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">700</span> get_helm.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
.</span>/get_helm.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sh</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>剩下就是，将以上页面出现的所有命令，都执行一遍，就可以了</p>
<p>最后一步Install OpenObserve collector，这里会根据你安装OpenObserve设定的token，自动生成安装命令，直接复制粘贴执行即可。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>四、仪表盘</h1>
<p>默认仪表盘是空的，需要手动导入。</p>
<p>官方仪表盘已经放到github了，链接：<a href="https://github.com/openobserve/dashboards" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/openobserve/dashboards</a></p>
</div>
<p class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114141645856-2054942394.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这里有N多仪表盘，但是目前我只需要k8s的，进入文件夹Kubernetes(openobserve-collector)</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114141807190-1167162461.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;将这里面的8个json文件，下载下来。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>点击导入</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114141901045-1089591817.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;点击添加</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114141928995-444589460.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;输入k8s</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114142001328-208418758.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>上传json文件，选择k8s文件夹，点击导入</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114142053271-606359443.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;导入完成后，可以看到8个</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114142111900-1550507002.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;点击第7个，刷新数据，效果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202511/1341090-20251114142204427-1646762763.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
